# dsh-skill-center · 技能中心
**English** · 中文

A Skill Center panel for **DeepSeek Harness**: browse every skill a session can see, switch which
se
ssion scope the panel follows, read its `SKILL.md`, flip the model/user invocation switches, create
and delete skills — without leaving the app and without hand-editing frontmatter. The package ships
`icon.svg` for the plugin manager and uses the same lightning mark for the sidebar entry, so the row
and the plugin card match.

> [!NOTE]
> The npm name `dsh-skill-center` is taken by an unrelated project, so this plugin is publ

ished as
> **`@restregular/dsh-skill-center`**. The plugin id stays `dsh-skill-center` / `skill-cent

d as
> **`@restregular/dsh-skill-center`**. The plugin id stays `dsh-skill-center` / `skill-center`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features
| Capability | Detail |
| Browse | Lists every skill visible in the **current session scope**, including skills embedded in

plugins, each with provider, source root and invocation policy |
| Switch scope | The **Scope** drop
down in the toolbar is a custom popup menu that browses another session's skill scope, with sessions
grouped by workspace while archived and blank sessions are left out. **Auto (current session)** kee
ps the original follow-the-main-view pick, while any listed session makes `list` and every write res
olve from that session's cwd and preset. It is disabled while invocation edits are staged, so a swit

ch can never carry them into a different scope |
| Search / filter | Search by name or description;

filter by provider source |
| Read body | Renders the raw `SKILL.md` Markdown inside the panel (no r

ight-hand resource pane needed) |
| Invocation switches | Flips `disable-model-invocation` / `user-i
nvocable` locally — the switch moves at once, with no round trip — and writes them into the frontmat
ter when you press **Save** beside *Back to session* (the button reads 未修改 → 保存 → 已保存); the host pus

hes the refreshed catalog to the model immediately |
| Create | Creates `<name>/SKILL.md` under the
user Agents or user DSH skills root; the form pairs **Create** with **Cancel**, and a hint under **W

rite to** explains what the choice means |
| Export / import | **Export** downloads the selected bun
dle as a `.zip` — `SKILL.md` plus every resource file under it, flat skills become `<name>.md`. **Im
port skill** accepts that `.zip` (a single wrapping folder is stripped) or a bare `SKILL.md`; it ref
uses entries whose paths escape the bundle, names that already exist, and files without frontmatter

`name` + `description` |
| Delete | Moves the skill to `.trash/<timestamp>-<name>` in the same root
— recoverable, never a hard delete; the confirmation puts **取消 / Cancel** to the left of **确认删除? / C

onfirm delete?** |
[该节后续省略]
### Write location: project roots vs the two user roots
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
- **DeepSeek Harness** desktop build that provides the `ctx.skills` registry and the loopback web se

rver.
- **Node.js ≥ 22.13.0** for the package metadata/engine field (the plugin itself is plain ESM
and has **zero runtime dependencies**).
## Architecture
Two halves, no shared imports:
**Host half** — `lib/index.js`

- Reads the catalog through `ctx.skills`, resolving scope with the same three-tier fallback as the
o
fficial `ctx.remote.skills`: live agent → session-recorded preset scope (`agentPresets.acquireScope`

)
→ global registry. The first two tiers decide whether the preset's `skill-filesystem` mount is vis

ible
(with the global tier only, embedded skills are all you see).
- Writes only touch files that li

ve in a managed skill root **and** exist on disk:
`<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills`, `<projectRoot>/.agent

s/skills`, `$DSH_HOME/skills`, `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills`.
- Frontmatter edits are string-level: only

the invocation keys are touched, everything else is preserved
byte for byte, including line-ending

style.
- For skills inside a managed root, `list` takes the invocation policy **from the file on dis

k** instead of
the registry snapshot. The skill catalog is cached and the filesystem watcher invalid

ates it a moment
after a write, so a panel that trusted the snapshot would show its own stale value

right after a save —
which is exactly what made a flipped switch snap back until a manual refresh.
-
Delete is a `rename` into `.trash`; `trash` lists those entries, `restore` renames one back (never
overwriting an existing skill), `deleteTrash` removes one for good, and `emptyTrash` clears them all

.
Trash operations resolve only the working directory — they do not need the skill registry, so they

keep working when the catalog read fails.
- Also registers an embedded skill provider (`ctx.skills.

registerProvider`) for `skills/skill-authoring/`
and the `skill_create` tool (`ctx.inject(['tools'],

…)` + `ctx.tools.register`). The tool schema is a
hand-written JSON Schema using only the subset `@

deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` accepts, so the package keeps
zero runtime dependencies and needs no host-sid

e module resolution.
- The three parts degrade independently: a missing `tools` or `webServer` servi

ce, or a bundled-skill
asset that fails to parse, only logs a warning and leaves the rest mounted.
**Browser half** — `client/client.js`
[该节后续省略]
### 功能
| 能力 | 说明 |

| 浏览 | 列出**当前会话作用域**下模型/用户能看到的所有技能（含插件内嵌技能），带提供方、来源根、调用策略 |
| 切换作用域 | 工具栏的**作用域**下拉可以查看另一个会话的技能目录：**
自动(当前会话)** 沿用原来「主区域会话 → 最近会话」的跟随逻辑；选中某个会话后，`list` 与全部写操作都按该会话的 cwd 与预设解析。有未保存的开关改动时下拉禁用，改动不会落到另一个作用域

|
| 搜索 / 筛选 | 按名称或描述搜索；按来源（provider source）筛选 |
| 查看正文 | 面板内直接读 `SKILL.md` 原文（Markdown 原文，不经过右栏） |
| 调用开关 | 开关先改本地状态（**点了立刻切换**，不发请求），再按「返回会话」左边的 **保存** 按钮写回 frontmatter（按钮三态：未修改 → 保存 → 已保存，多个技能待保存时显

示「保存 (n)」）；写盘后监听器立刻把新目录推给模型 |
